Branch is imo the best term, in graph theory and computer science it refers to a subset of the scene graph and its descendants, and it's easy to understand because of the analogy with a plant (that's why we call it a "tree").

In retrospect `control` would probably be better here than `switch` or `toggle`, as it's actually an enum : "OFF, ON, INHERIT".

I have changed in the `SceneTree`, but it's debatable whether this is really required as it refers to the `ProjectSetting`. Realistically it seems unlikely that anyone will be changing this who is not familiar with the project setting (and it may end up being removed, see #102762 ).

body:
Branch is imo the best term, in graph theory and computer science it refers to a subset of the scene graph and its descendants, and it's easy to understand because of the analogy with a plant (that's why we call it a "tree").

In retrospect `control` would probably be better here than `switch` or `toggle`, as it's actually an enum : "OFF, ON, INHERIT".

I have changed in the `SceneTree`, but it's debatable whether this is really required as it refers to the `ProjectSetting`. Realistically it seems unlikely that anyone will be changing this who is not familiar with the project setting (and it may end up being removed, see #102762 ).
